annotations.text:
EDITORIAL DIRECTION — iPhone
Warm bone canvas, Newsreader serif for headings and figures, thin rules instead of cards, one rust accent, desaturated pastel status tags, translucent nav + tab bar. Sample data. Tokens: design-canvas/tokens.css.

TASKS + PROJECTS
Tasks: filter as underlined text tabs (not pills), thin-circle checkboxes, day-grouped with sticky headers, due day in serif. Projects: list entries not cards — name in serif, pastel status tag, one hairline progress bar, milestone count + next step. Swipe-to-edit/delete unchanged from the current app.
